chain.title: I'm going on an adventure…
chain.stem: I'm going on an adventure and I'm taking
chain.tip: Tutor starts: "I'm going on an adventure and I'm taking a net." Tap the picture, then the child repeats the whole list and adds one more. Use 🙈 Hide the list to make it a real memory challenge, and 👀 to check. Keep it light and let the child win the last round!
